capabilities: Publish notes, folders, and PDFs to Feishu/Lark Docs and update the same document on later syncs
Sync bound notes incrementally so only changed blocks are rewritten remotely
Rewrite note links between synced notes and PDF references to point to remote documents
Exclude files or folders from sync using .feishuignore rules
Trigger automatic sync after save or through a Git pre-push hook
extras: Desktop only and requires a recent Obsidian version; default settings language is Chinese. Sync is one-way (local wins), so remote edits must be merged back manually. Replaces the archived feishu-lark-cli-sync plugin ID and migrates its data automatically.
intentEvidence: Forked from wanghuan9/obsidian-feishu-lark-cli-sync by huan.wang (wanghuan) under the MIT License.
motivation: The original Feishu Lark CLI Sync repository and author are gone and the plugin was archived, so the author forked it to continue maintenance and add published-link management, PDF sync, and dedup.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share notes with a team as native Feishu/Lark documents that stay up to date after edits.

relations.evidence: Forked from wanghuan9/obsidian-feishu-lark-cli-sync by huan.wang (wanghuan) under the MIT License.

requires.name: Node.js with npm (lark-cli is installed by the plugin)

summary: Publishes Obsidian Markdown notes, folders, and PDFs to Feishu/Lark Docs through lark-cli and keeps bound documents updated in place with one-way sync.
